description: Human exception-review queue (read-only). Returns items from data/review/queue.json for Ho Hum (sole human operator). Default status=open; pass status=all for history. Approve/reject is offline file edit only — write_api is always false; there is no unauthenticated write/approve API. Agents must never auto-clear trust flags or invent CE/EINs/donate URLs to close tickets.

status.description: Filter by item status (default open on the server)
